name: Digital System Design
topics: Combinational Design with Decoders and MUX
Design the given combinational circuit using a decoder and external gates.
Implement the given Boolean function using an 8:1 MUX; differentiate positive and negative logic.
Latches, Flip-Flops and Excitation Tables
Draw the NOR-gate RS latch and the edge-triggered RS flip-flop with truth tables; differentiate level and edge triggering.
Give the excitation tables and state diagrams of D, T, SR and JK flip-flops.
Counters and Shift Registers
Design a 3-bit ripple down counter using T flip-flops and a synchronous MOD-5 counter using JK flip-flops.
Write notes on ring and Johnson counters and shift registers with timing diagrams.
Finite State Machines: Mealy and Moore
Differentiate Mealy and Moore machines; draw the state diagram and tables for the 1010 sequence detector.
List the capabilities and limitations of FSMs; explain the transition matrix and secondary state assignment.
State Reduction and Asynchronous Sequential Circuits
Explain the steps to reduce flow tables of completely and incompletely specified machines.
Explain races and hazards in asynchronous machines and how to avoid them; compare pulse mode and fundamental mode.
VHDL Modelling and Synthesis
Write VHDL code for a full subtractor and a 4×1 MUX in dataflow and behavioural styles.
Explain delay mechanisms, library and entity, data types/objects, test benches, design for testability and RTL vs behavioural synthesis.
Programmable Logic: ROM, PLA, PAL
Differentiate ROM, PLA and PAL.
Implement the given functions using a PLA.
